title: Hearty Braised Turkish Cabbage Su Boregi
description: A weeknight Turkish dish featuring deep-fried flatbread, cabbage leaves, and a rich, earthy broth.

ingredients.name: Turkish flatbread (Sucukli Yuvarlak)
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Heat the oil in a large tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage leaves and cook until wilted, about 10 minutes.
Add the salt, black pepper, chicken broth, beef broth, red wine, and tomato paste. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and bring the liquid to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, deep-fry the flatbread pieces until crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
To serve, place a few pieces of flatbread in the bottom of a bowl, then spoon the braised cabbage and broth over the top.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
